description:
What renting households actually pay: weekly rent in 14 bands from under $75 to $950 or more, the median weekly rent, and who the landlord is (agent, private owner, public or community housing), for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 5,400 suburbs and localities and 536 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/rent-payments`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_renting_households, rent_1_74_count, rent_1_74_pct, rent_75_99_count, rent_75_99_pct, rent_100_149_count, rent_100_149_pct, rent_150_199_count, rent_150_199_pct, rent_200_224_count, rent_200_224_pct, rent_225_274_count, rent_225_274_pct, rent_275_349_count, rent_275_349_pct, rent_350_449_count, rent_350_449_pct, rent_450_549_count, rent_450_549_pct, rent_550_649_count, rent_550_649_pct, rent_650_749_count, rent_650_749_pct, rent_750_849_count, rent_750_849_pct, rent_850_949_count, rent_850_949_pct, rent_950_plus_count, rent_950_plus_pct, rent_not_stated_count, rent_not_stated_pct, landlord_real_estate_agent_count, landlord_real_estate_agent_pct, landlord_private_person_count, landlord_private_person_pct, landlord_state_housing_count, landlord_state_housing_pct, landlord_community_housing_count, landlord_community_housing_pct, landlord_other_count, landlord_other_pct, landlord_not_stated_count, landlord_not_stated_pct, median_rent_weekly. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
